item.title: Thatsaid 1.5.35
item.description:
Thatsaid 1.5.35
- Dictation: clipboard is restored only after the paste lands (Electron apps included); smart spacing.
- Crash-safe recording: audio is written in small chunks and recovered after a crash; chunks are deleted after processing.
- Mic recovery: survives device changes without breaking 24x7 listening; never touches the mic while paused.
- No naming popup while the dictation key is held.
- Retention settings for transcripts and recorded audio (audio deleted by default, never kept over 7 days).
- Meeting app hints (Zoom, Teams, FaceTime, Webex) and optional Calendar titles plus heads-up.
- Experimental echo cancellation (off by default).
- Cross-meeting voice matching.
Thanks to OpenWhispr (MIT) for ideas.

item.title: Thatsaid 1.5.34
item.description:
Thatsaid 1.5.34
- Fixed a freeze at launch when Thatsaid starts paused before microphone access is decided. The watchdog used to restart the app over and over while the mic prompt waited.

item.title: Thatsaid 1.5.33
item.description:
Thatsaid 1.5.33
- Dictation now types into Electron and Chrome-based apps (Slack, Discord, VS Code, Chrome, Grok Bot and similar). Before, the text silently went nowhere.

item.title: Thatsaid 1.5.32
item.description:
Thatsaid 1.5.32
- Grant Access now shows only macOS's own prompt. Click Open System Settings in it, and Thatsaid's guide appears next to the Accessibility list.
- If macOS is holding an Accessibility grant from an older build (it shows ON but typing is still blocked), Dictation says so and walks you through removing it with − and adding it again.
- Thatsaid not in the list? Drag the app icon from the guide into it.

item.title: Thatsaid 1.5.31
item.description:
Thatsaid 1.5.31
- Dictation: if macOS hasn't granted Accessibility, the text goes to your clipboard (press ⌘V) and you get a notification. It no longer looks inserted when it wasn't.
- Settings → Dictation tells you when macOS still holds an Accessibility grant from an older build, and how to fix it.
- Dictation is faster: the speech model stays loaded while dictation is on, so it no longer loads on your first hold.
- Settings: Updates now appears only under General (no duplicate under Mode).

item.title: Thatsaid 1.5.29
item.description:
Thatsaid 1.5.29
- Fix: Install and Relaunch now installs the update and relaunches

item.title: Thatsaid 1.5.28
item.description:
Thatsaid 1.5.28
- New Updates settings: Check for updates automatically (on) and Update silently (off)
- Check for Updates button and current version in Settings
- Updates never install during a recording

item.title: Thatsaid 1.5.27
item.description:
Thatsaid 1.5.27
- Grant Access button and on-screen guide for Accessibility (dictation) and Microphone
- Signed with Developer ID and notarized
- Automatic updates via Sparkle; never installs during a recording
